verdict.rationale: Twenty's workflows let users define event-triggered automations. Triggers include record changes, schedules, manual actions and incoming webhooks, and custom objects get the same workflow triggers. Actions can chain record operations, email, HTTP requests, custom JavaScript, branches, iterators, delays and AI agent steps, all built without code. The core of the story is well documented in first-party docs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that event-triggered workflows work reliably in practice.
